clues.it: Irene era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a un serbatoio e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Irene was in the 8th column, beside a fuel tank and north of Nino.

clues.it: Giada era nella 2ª colonna e da sola nel Criosonno, ma non era accanto a una vasca idroponica.
clues.en: Giada was in the 2nd column and alone in the Cryo Bay, but was not beside a hydroponic tank.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 3ª riga, accanto a un serbatoio e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 3rd row, beside a fuel tank and west of Irene.

clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª colonna, a ovest di Irene e in Serra.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd column, west of Irene and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Nino era seduto su una sedia e accanto a un'antenna, ma non era accanto a un fascio di cavi.
clues.en: Nino was sitting on a chair and beside an antenna, but was not beside a cable bundle.

clues.it: Marta era nella 6ª riga, seduta su una sedia e a nord di Sergio.
clues.en: Marta was in the 6th row, sitting on a chair and north of Sergio.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a una poltrona e nella stessa stanza di Marta.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a flight seat and in the same room as Marta.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un fascio di cavi e in una stanza diversa da Giada.
clues.en: Elena was beside a cable bundle and in a different room from Giada.

clues.it: Carla era nella 9ª riga e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Carla was in the 9th row and west of Olga.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

1 accanto a una perdita di refrigerante.

steps.it: L'indizio di Irene lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Irene's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 7th.

steps.en: Nino can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 2nd, column 2nd.

steps.en: Marta can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 8th, column 1st.
